name: Doing Poorly and Living with Myself
source:
Doing Poorly and Living with Myself is a short semi-autobiographical Visual Novel about work, stress, imposter syndrome and burnout.  

[From [url=https://noahkittleson.itch.io/dpalm]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《做得不好，与自己共存》是一部关于工作、压力、冒名顶替综合症和倦怠的半自传体短篇视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://noahkittleson.itch.io/dpalm]Itch.io[/url]]
